test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The difference between a male and a female still ______ in our society. In this era where women have such great achievements in every field, still in some sections of our community, a man is always termed as superior to women.
solution:
The correct answer is '**persists**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**persists**" means continues to exist or endure over a prolonged period. (बनी रहती है)
 
• Despite the progress and achievements made by women, certain societal sections still maintain the notion of male superiority.
 
• The other options: "**defects**," "**insists**," and "**requires**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The difference between a male and a female still persists__ in our society. In this era where women have such great achievements in every field, still in some sections of our community, a man is always termed as superior to women.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Defects (त्रुटियाँ)**: means flaws or imperfections.
 
• **Insists (ज़िद करना)**: means to demand forcefully or persistently.
 
• **Requires (आवश्यकता)**: means needs something as essential or necessary.
